task: Repair the two critical cross-lane integration defects (F1+F2) that block the product's central schedule-application flow from SHA ec916b75d5600e02d679d264648ac92333d721f1. The platform apply-plan endpoint correctly enforces Contract §9.2 (body must be exactly { confirmedDiffHash }; inline plans rejected), but (a) no production ConfirmedPlanLookup implementation or POST /confirm-diff registration endpoint exists anywhere in the repository (F2), and (b) the dashboard bridge sends { ops, confirmedDiffHash } which the endpoint rejects with 400 (F1). Both must be repaired together for the apply flow to function. Integration lane owns the platform HTTP layer and must: (1) add a ConfirmedPlanStore interface extending ConfirmedPlanLookup with a register(ref) method; (2) implement an in-memory production ConfirmedPlanStore (Map-backed, bound to app-lifetime scope); (3) add a POST /confirm-diff endpoint handler in mutationEndpoints.ts that accepts { confirmedDiffHash, plan: MutationPlan, confirmedBy: string }, validates body shape strictly, writes the ConfirmedPlanReference via the store, and returns { confirmedDiffHash }; (4) export the new endpoint, types, and store from src/platform/http/index.ts; (5) update src/platform/http/README.md endpoint map with the new row; (6) wire the ConfirmedPlanStore instance in the composition root (src/platform/composition/index.ts) so both confirm-diff and apply-plan share the same backing store; (7) add platform-layer tests (tests/platform/http-mutations.spec.ts or new spec) covering: confirm-diff happy path, confirm-diff body validation (rejects extra keys, missing fields), confirm-diff idempotency (same hash re-registration), confirm-then-apply round-trip, apply without prior confirm returns NOT_FOUND, apply with stale/replaced hash still resolves correctly; (8) include a cross-lane coordination note for the dashboard lane: bridge.requestApply must drop the ops parameter (send only { confirmedDiffHash }), a new bridge.confirmDiff(confirmedDiffHash, plan) method must call POST /confirm-diff, and rulesEditorPage.handleApply must call confirmDiff before requestApply. The integration candidate must not modify dashboard files; the dashboard bridge fix is a separate downstream task but the task description must make the contract explicit so the auditor can verify cross-lane consistency.
reason: F1 and F2 are the only critical defects from the integrated audit. The apply-plan flow is the product's central destructive-but-consented mutation path (Contract §9.2; Blueprint §4 flow-3). Without a production ConfirmedPlanLookup and a confirm-diff registration endpoint, the apply endpoint can never resolve the hash to a plan (F2), and the dashboard bridge body contradiction (F1) means the apply call would fail with HTTP 400 even if the lookup existed. The integration lane is the sole owner of src/platform/http/ (the endpoint handlers, the ConfirmedPlanLookup seam, the composition root, and the endpoint map README). The dashboard bridge fix is trivial but downstream: it cannot function without the confirm-diff endpoint existing first. Fixing integration first unblocks both the deterministic test coverage for the full apply flow and the dashboard lane's subsequent bridge repair. All other lanes (rules, billing) remain clean per the integrated audit's verified-clean areas.
